test_CNNQValueNetwork_forward_pass: test the CNNQValueNetwork forward pass by building a network and calling get_q_values on MNIST image batches
test_CNNQValueMultiHeadNetwork_forward_p: test the CNNQValueMultiHeadNetwork forward pass by building a multi-head network and calling get_q_values with one-hot actions
build_CNNQValueNetwork: build a CNNQValueNetwork with configurable kernel sizes, output channels, strides, and hidden dimensions for image-based Q-value estimation
build_CNNQValueMultiHeadNetwork: build a CNNQValueMultiHeadNetwork with multi-head output for Q-value estimation on image observations with one-hot action encoding
run_get_q_values: run get_q_values on a batch of image observations and action tensors to obtain Q-value predictions from the network
